brief:
An Italian artist has unveiled a work titled "Holy Mothers of Gaza" inside Naples' Pappacoda Chapel, according to Al Jazeera English. Eduardo Castaldo reimagined classical Madonna paintings to expose the humanitarian crisis in Gaza, inserting contemporary imagery into the religious artistic tradition.

The exhibition displays the artist's effort to bridge historical religious iconography with current geopolitical conflict, positioning the chapel as a space where medieval and modern suffering converge through visual reinterpretation.
dek: Italian artist Eduardo Castaldo has unveiled an artwork titled ‘Holy Mothers of Gaza’ inside Naples’ Pappacoda Chapel.
title: Italian artist exhibits Madonna paintings recontextualized to reflect Gaza suffering
